prompt.text: Read the three squares from left to right. The dot moves one quarter turn clockwise each time. Which square comes next?
prompt.alt: Three squares in reading order, with dots at upper left, upper right, then lower right.

rationale.worked: Follow the dot around the square: upper left → upper right → lower right → lower left. B shows lower left. D also shows lower left, so the item has two correct drawings.

distractors.A: Upper right moves back one corner.
distractors.C: Upper left skips ahead two corners.

reviewReason: B and D both draw the dot at lower left. The paths and IDs differ, but both drawings solve the prompt.
